summary: Explains embedding custom modules in standalone roles via a `library/` directory, making them usable in that role and roles called after it. Roles in collections can't do this. You can also override a core module with a development copy, with caution, and embed plugins the same way.
questions: How do I ship a custom module with my role so others don't need to set the library path?
Can roles in a collection embed modules in a library folder?
Which roles can use a module embedded in another role?
Can I override a built-in module with my own copy via a role?

answer_card.title: Embed modules in roles
answer_card.answer_md:
Only for **standalone** roles; roles in collections must use the collection's `plugins` structure.

Add a `library/` directory next to `tasks/` and `handlers/`:
```text
roles/
  my_custom_modules/
    library/
      module1
      module2
```
The modules are usable in that role and in roles called **after** it:
```yaml
- hosts: webservers
  roles:
    - my_custom_modules
    - some_other_role_using_my_custom_modules
```
You can also embed a copy of a core module (e.g. a development version) to override it, but use caution: core APIs may change and this isn't guaranteed to work. Plugins can be embedded the same way.
